title: Physics-informed neural networks for strain-dependent bandgaps in diamond
description:
Code and data for predicting the electronic bandgap of strained diamond from the six-component Green-Lagrange strain tensor. A neural network is trained on hybrid-functional reference calculations while being required to agree with deformation-potential and Bir-Pikus models of how strain shifts the band edges.

Includes the dataset of 1,292 deformation states with band-edge energies, the analytic physics models and their calibration routine, the training program for every model variant, the studies that established each setting, the ablation and validation scripts, and the figure pipeline.
